name: uww-canvas-chatgpt
description: Connect Codex in ChatGPT desktop to UW-Whitewater Canvas with local token prompts and encrypted storage.

interface.shortDescription: Courses, due dates, grades, files, and discussions in desktop Codex.
interface.longDescription: Read your UW-Whitewater Canvas coursework in the local Codex experience of ChatGPT desktop. A local prompt saves your token with Windows DPAPI or macOS Keychain. Submissions and posts require on-screen confirmation.
defaultPrompt: What is due next in Canvas?
